messages:
julia: Quick sync: Product needs a clear prioritization approach and safe A/B rollout plan for the "priority slicing" initiative. Who's in?
mikael: I'm in. quick take: RICE is good for ranking but misses operational risk. propose hybrid: RICE base score + explicit risk adjustment.
suresh: customers press for latency SLO; that's high impact. Effort spans runtime changes + routing logic, moderate size.
anna: Can we lock launch gates now? I propose p95 <= 280ms, total error rate <0.4%, and no >1.5% quality regression on our customer eval set.
julia: Agreed. I prefer tighter p95 (<=250ms) but can accept 280ms for MVP. Call out rollback triggers too.
mikael: Here's a quick hybrid calc I sketched: Reach=7, Impact=8, Confidence=0.7, Effort=2.5 months -> RICE= (7*8*0.7)/2.5=15.68. Apply risk_adj=0.9 for high infra complexity -> final ~14.1
suresh: note: routing change adds stateful handling risk. mark infra-risk=1.3 if new prefix cache semantics enabled.
anna: rollout sequencing suggestion: internal dev-team 0.5% -> internal org 2% -> selected pilot customers 5% -> broad prod 20% -> full 100%. require 12h minimum per step plus green checks.
eng: 12h seems tight for overnight cycles; suggest 24h min for prod steps.
product-ops-bot: added guardrails: auto-rollback if error_rate >2x baseline OR p95 > baseline*1.4 OR quality_regression >2%.
julia: Fallback strategy: revert traffic to previous model variant and disable the new routing flag. also revert prefix-cache tuning.
mikael: Also add degraded path: on latency regression, route non-critical routes to async worker queue and lower token budget for heavy prompts.
suresh: Metrics to watch during canary: p50/p95, 95/99 quantiles for tails, classified error types, hallucination rate on eval suite, token spend, latency by customer segment.
anna: Experiment design: A/B with deterministic bucketing; primary metric = conversion of success (quality pass) at target latency. Secondary = cost per completion.
julia: Kill criteria: any single canary step failing 2 hard checks (latency SLO, error rate, quality) OR >=4 customer complaints in 24h triggers immediate rollback.
eng: deployment snippet for ops:
```
feature_flag: priority_slice_v1
rollout: [0.005, 0.02, 0.05, 0.2, 1.0]
min_observation_hours: 24
auto_rollback_triggers: [error_rate, p95_latency, quality_regression]
```
anna: Scope negotiation: MVP = routing + guardrail infra + canary automation. defer batching/quantization and dedicated capacity integration to post-GA backlog.
suresh: customer ask for dedicated pools is noted as a separate EPIC; non-blocker for MVP.
julia: Next steps: 1) mikael to share hybrid RICE + risk doc by EOD Tue. 2) eng to draft rollout automation and alerts. 3) product-ops to schedule pilot and own the post-mortem template. sync 30m after docs.
product-ops-bot: actions logged: @mikael produce doc, @eng draft rollout, @product-ops schedule pilot. due Tue 17:00.
deploy-bot: FYI - staging canary runner available at `staging-canary` queue.
anna: pinging CS to prep customer comms for pilot. :white_check_mark:
julia: Thanks all — we'll reconvene after the docs.
